findings.quote: columns Title (pinned icon + link to edit when allowed), Audience (group name; "Everyone" for null), Publishes/Published (`formatInOrgZone`), Expires, State badge (`ANNOUNCEMENT_STATE_LABELS`), Push (managers only, …), Actions (Edit / Delete)
findings.problem: The prompt deliberately builds a member view ("Members without any `announcements.*` permission can open the list and see only what RLS lets them see") but the table never renders the `body`, and there is no detail route or dialog. A plain member therefore sees titles only and has no way on the web to read an announcement; managers likewise cannot preview the text without opening the edit form. The skeleton bullet lists `body` as a first-class field and the plan's list page is the only web surface for announcements (no `/announcements/[id]`).
findings.fix: In Build 9 add: "Every row expands (shadcn `Collapsible`, or a `View` button opening a `Dialog`) to show the full plain-text body (`whitespace-pre-wrap`), the audience name, publish/expiry times in the org zone and, for managers, the push status. The member view uses the same component. Add `AnnouncementsTable.test.tsx` case: expanding a row renders the body text." Add to done_when 1: "… and can expand a row to read the body."

findings.quote: `dispatch.test.ts` — … 250 tokens → 3 `sendChunks` calls of ≤ 100 (assert through the fake, using the SDK's chunk size constant, not a literal)
findings.problem: PLAN §10 step 9 and the skeleton require "dispatch tests with mocked SDK", and Verify expects `src/lib/push/expo.ts (+ its test)`, but Build 9 lists no test for `expo.ts` — the only file that touches `expo-server-sdk` (token validation, `chunkPushNotifications`, rejected-chunk isolation, receipt-id chunking). The chunking assertion is also placed in the wrong layer: per Build 1 `sendChunks(messages)` receives ALL messages and chunks internally, so the fake transport sees exactly one call and "3 `sendChunks` calls" can never be observed. Chunking — an explicit PLAN §12 unit-test item ("push dispatch (claiming, chunking, skip unpublished)") — ends up untested.
findings.fix: Add to Build 9: "`expo.test.ts` — `vi.mock('expo-server-sdk')` with a fake `Expo` class exposing `isExpoPushToken`, `chunkPushNotifications` (delegating to the real static chunk size), `sendPushNotificationsAsync`, `chunkPushNotificationReceiptIds`, `getPushNotificationReceiptsAsync`: 250 messages → `sendPushNotificationsAsync` called `Math.ceil(250 / Expo.pushNotificationChunkSizeLimit)` times; one rejected chunk → that chunk yields `{ tickets: [], error }` and the other chunks' tickets are returned; `getReceipts` batches ids and merges the maps; `isValidToken` rejects a non-Expo string." Reword the dispatch test to: "250 devices → the fake transport receives one `sendChunks` call with 250 messages, whose tickets are mapped 1:1 onto `insertDeliveries` rows". Add `expo` to the Verify suite list.

findings.quote: `afterContentPublish()` in `src/lib/push/after-publish.ts` runs the dispatcher synchronously with the service client and never throws into the Server Action
findings.problem: done_when 2 asserts the never-throws contract, but Build 9 names no test for `after-publish.ts`; a regression here would surface as a failed publish for the founder (the Server Action would 500 when Expo is unreachable).
findings.fix: Add to Build 9: "`after-publish.test.ts` — mock `dispatchQueued` to throw → resolves `{ dispatched: false }` and logs; mock it to return a summary → `{ dispatched: true, summary }`; `createServiceSupabase` is called exactly once per call." Add `after-publish` to the Verify suite list.

findings.quote: run it twice concurrently (`& wait`) → both 200, no duplicate deliveries
findings.problem: DESIGN §11 Phase 3 acceptance is "cron idempotent under concurrent invocation"; the prompt relies on a manual curl against a live project only (which the executability review notes cannot run against the local shim). There is no automated proof of idempotency.
findings.fix: Add to `tick.test.ts` in Build 9: "two `runTick` calls started with `Promise.all` against a fake `srvClaimNotifications` that hands each queued row out exactly once (models `skip locked`) and a fake `listStorageDeletions` that returns the same rows to both → `insertDeliveries` is called once per row and `markStorageDeletionDone` is idempotent (second call is a no-op, no throw)."

findings.quote: **Docs**: `docs/ENV.md` — rows for `CRON_SECRET` … and `EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN` …; `README.md`: one line pointing there.
findings.problem: Step 2.1 created `apps/web/.env.example`; this is the first step that actually reads `CRON_SECRET` and `EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN` in web code (via `serverEnv()`), but the prompt does not ask to confirm both appear there with placeholders, so a local developer copying `.env.example` gets 503 from the cron route with no hint.
findings.fix: Append to Build 8: "Ensure `apps/web/.env.example` (2.1a) contains `CRON_SECRET=` and `EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN=` with comment lines (`# openssl rand -hex 32`; `# optional — Expo access token`); add them if missing."

findings.quote: `updateAnnouncement(orgSlug, id, form)` — `announcements.edit`; `getAnnouncement` first (404 → `not_found`); `updateAnnouncement(db, id, { ...input, updated_by })`; 0 rows updated → …; then `afterContentPublish`
findings.problem: Create and delete call `revalidatePath('/o/<slug>/announcements')`; the update action does not, so after an edit the list (and the dashboard count) can show stale data until the Next cache expires.
findings.fix: Insert after the 0-rows clause: "`revalidatePath('/o/<slug>/announcements')` and `revalidatePath('/o/<slug>/announcements/<id>/edit')`; then `afterContentPublish`".

findings.quote: sign in as a plain member → only Active rows, no Push column, no buttons
findings.problem: done_when 1 promises "new requires `announcements.create`, edit requires `announcements.edit`" (PLAN §8/§9: `requirePerm` per page), but neither Verify nor the test list checks the direct-URL path: a member typing `/o/<slug>/announcements/new` or `/announcements/<id>/edit` must get 3.1's 403 page, and a user with `announcements.create` but not `.edit` must be refused on the edit page.
findings.fix: Add to the manual Verify script: "as the plain member open `/o/<slug>/announcements/new` and `/o/<slug>/announcements/<id>/edit` directly → 3.1's 403 page; as a `announcements.create`-only account the edit URL → 403 while `/new` works." Add to Build 11 `actions.test.ts`: "update without `announcements.edit` → `permission_denied`; delete without `announcements.delete` → `permission_denied`."

findings.quote: State checklist — tick the `announcements` part of "Web: announcements + bulletins" (bulletins remain open for 3.5b)
findings.problem: HANDOFF.md's State list has no such item; the web line is a single combined entry ("Web: auth, super admin, org admin (users/permissions, settings, sermons, share links, announcements, bulletins, push, cron)"). The agent cannot find the item it is told to tick; 3.5b ("tick the `bulletins` half") and 3.6 ("tick 'Web: push + cron'") have the same problem.
findings.fix: In all three Finish blocks replace the tick instruction with: "In HANDOFF.md State, mark the sub-items of the combined web line the way steps 3.1–3.4 did (e.g. `announcements ✔ (3.5a)` inside the parentheses, or split the line into per-feature checkboxes if an earlier step already did); do not invent a new item."

findings.problem: RLS grants `bulletins.upload` holders update on `bulletins` (DESIGN §6 "same"), and the skeleton lists "list, delete" only, but the prompt never says whether a title or date-range typo can be corrected after upload. Left unstated, one agent will add an edit dialog and another will not; the founder's only path today is delete + re-upload, which also re-sends a push.
findings.fix: Add to Constraints: "No edit of a published bulletin in this step (title/date typos → delete and upload again; say so in the Delete confirm text). Metadata editing is a Phase 2 polish item." Add an open_issue: "Bulletin metadata edit (title, range) is not planned anywhere; propose it for 3.10 or 5.7."

findings.quote: abandoned incomplete rows are visible only to `bulletins.upload` holders who can Resume or Discard them
findings.problem: DESIGN §4.4 `srv_housekeeping()` "deletes upload-kind draft rows > 7 days without objects" — if 1.3b applied that to `bulletins` (publish_at null) the docs paragraph is incomplete (abandoned drafts vanish after a week); if it applies only to sermons the founder should know incomplete bulletin rows persist forever. The prompt does not ask the agent to check.
findings.fix: Append to Build 8: "Read the `srv_housekeeping` body in `9999_init.sql`: state whether incomplete bulletin rows are purged after 7 days by the 3.6 cron or persist until discarded, and record which in docs/ENV.md and HANDOFF."

findings.quote: `pnpm --filter web build` → succeeds; the route list contains `/api/cron/tick` (ƒ dynamic).
findings.problem: The Playwright smoke item in PLAN §12 covers "unauth redirects" and "security headers"; the cron route is excluded from the `proxy.ts` matcher (PLAN §7) — nothing in Verify asserts that exclusion still holds after this step (a matcher change would make Vercel's cron call redirect to `/login` and every tick fail silently).
findings.fix: Add to Verify: "`grep -n 'cron/tick' apps/web/proxy.ts` → the matcher exclusion is present; `curl -i localhost:3000/api/cron/tick` returns 401/503 JSON, never a 307 to `/login`."
